critical_code_review_comments: SupportWidget.tsx L354: initial inheritFont uses document.body (sans-serif). Since the inherit font is only re-read on host mount via getComputedStyle(host.parentElement...), initial render for a brief moment may use body font. In the preview this now works correctly because preview-screen is the host parent and has STORE_FONT applied, but initial state could flicker. Low priority.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 sidebar changes + font bug fix verified end-to-end at 1440 and 768 viewports in both Admin and Agent roles. Font read via computed CSS var --gw-font and panel fontFamily on the widget shadowRoot inside [data-testid=preview-screen].
